Record ID: the bank's identifier for the reported asset line.
Collateral class: the asset category from the Appendix III asset category table.
Market value: the fair value under GAAP at close of business on the as-of date, in USD.
Treasury control: whether the asset meets the operational requirements for eligible HQLA (Yes = true).
Fiction.Bank:Fr2052A.Fields.CollateralCl: A-1-Q: Debt issued by the U.S. Treasury; HQLA Level 1.
A-2-Q: U.S. Government Agency-issued debt with a US Government guarantee; HQLA Level 1.
S-1-Q: Debt issued by non-U.S. sovereigns (excluding central banks) with a 0% risk weight; HQLA Level 1.
CB-1-Q: Securities issued or guaranteed by a central bank with a 0% risk weight; HQLA Level 1.
G-1-Q: Senior to preferred debt issued by a U.S. GSE; HQLA Level 2A.
G-2-Q: Vanilla debt (including pass-through MBS) guaranteed by a U.S. GSE; HQLA Level 2A.
S-5-Q: Debt issued by non-U.S. sovereigns with a 20% risk weight; HQLA Level 2A.
E-1-Q: U.S. equities in the Russell 1000; HQLA Level 2B.
IG-1-Q: Investment grade corporate debt; HQLA Level 2B.
IG-2-Q: Investment grade municipal obligations; HQLA Level 2B.
G-1: Senior to preferred GSE debt that fails the section 20 tests; not HQLA.
E-1: Russell 1000 equities that fail the section 20 tests; not HQLA.
E-3: All other U.S.-listed common equity securities; not HQLA.
IG-3: Investment grade vanilla ABS; not HQLA.
Z-1: All other assets; not HQLA.
Level 1: the highest-quality assets, counted at full market value.
Level 2A: counted at 85% of market value, subject to the Level 2 cap.
Level 2B: counted at 50% of market value, subject to the Level 2 and Level 2B caps.
Not HQLA: excluded from the HQLA amount.
